observations: Industrial sewing machine head mounted on a standard table with metal stand, red footswitch pedal visible in all photos
Brand name 'EMEL' visible in white lettering on machine head in photo 1 and photo 2
LED/LCD control panel on machine head suggesting an electronic/direct-drive servo motor built into the head
Thread stand with two spool holders attached to table, bobbin winder visible near handwheel
No motor box or belt visible under the table, consistent with a direct-drive head, but the drive unit itself is not clearly shown in any photo
No power cable, plug, or wall socket connection visible in any photo
No fabric under the needle, no stitching sample shown, machine not shown running or threaded for a test
Tiled floor and furnished room in background, appears to be a home or small workshop setting

claims.evidence: No usage logs, invoice, or wear indicators (e.g. close-up of hook/bobbin area, handwheel, belt) shown in any photo
No power-on test, no stitching sample, no close-up of needle/feed dog/tension area in any photo
Cosmetic condition looks clean in photos 0-3, but 'as new' functional claim cannot be judged from static photos

risks.risk: Direct-drive motor/servo unit (built into head, controlled by the LCD panel) may be faulty or not functioning
risks.proof: Video clip of machine powered on, pedal pressed, and stitching a few inches of fabric at varying speeds

risks.risk: Electrical wiring, power cord, or control panel could be damaged or missing from the listing photos
risks.proof: Photo of the power cord, plug head, and rear/underside of the control box

risks.risk: Needle plate, feed dogs, hook timing, or bobbin case could be worn or misaligned despite cosmetic cleanliness
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the needle plate/hook area and a stitched fabric sample

risks.risk: Table/stand could have structural wobble, rust, or damage not visible at the given angles
risks.proof: Photo from underneath the table showing stand joints and welds
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic-only, structural condition assumed unverified

proof_requests: Video of the machine powered on and sewing a seam at low and high speed
Close-up photo of the hook, bobbin case, and feed dog area
Photo of the power cord and plug
Photo showing the full underside of the table and stand joints
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as an EMEL industrial direct-drive sewing machine with table and stand, but no functional test, stitching sample, or close-up of wear-prone parts is shown, so all 'as new/no fault' claims remain unverifiable and the unit must be priced at worst case (assume unverified working condition) until proof is given.
